name: Vivasvan
reason: Sun god of the Rigveda, father of Manu; established name. IAST vivasvat is the stem form and disagrees with the name and Devanagari विवस्वान्; corrected to vivasvān.

name: Khagendra
reason: Khaga (bird) + indra (lord), an epithet of Garuda; used as a boy's name. Script and IAST agree.

name: Laya
reason: Rhythm, absorption; used for both genders, especially girls. Script and IAST agree.
